faq.question: Which lines of business does True Aim support?
faq.answer: True Aim is not tied to a single line. Motor, property, warranty and liability claims are built from the same components, each running on its own policy wording and rules.

faq.question: Who makes the final decision?
faq.answer: Your adjusters. True Aim prepares a recommendation with its full reasoning, and a person confirms it. Full automation runs only where you and your regulator permit it.

faq.question: Do we have to replace our claims system?
faq.answer: No. True Aim sits above the claims or ERP system you already run, reads each claim from it and writes its results back.

faq.question: How is True Aim priced?
faq.answer: Per outcome, not per seat. You pay for each settled claim, benchmarked invoice or completed damage report, so costs rise only with the value you receive.

hero.title: Claims captured and handled from the first call
hero.summary: Brokers are often the first call after a loss. With True Aim, P&C claims are captured on first contact, checked against the policy and kept moving, with your client informed at every step and the insurer's decision explained in full, line by line.

items.text: Your client, the insurer and the repairer all work from the same claim record, so everyone sees the same status.

faq.question: Does True Aim replace the insurer's decision?
faq.answer: No. The insurer decides. True Aim checks each claim against the policy wording and shows the clause behind every line, so you can explain the outcome to your client with confidence.

faq.question: Through which channels can a claim arrive?
faq.answer: WhatsApp, email, phone or a client portal. Documents are read as they arrive and brought together in one claim record.

faq.question: How do we keep our clients informed?
faq.answer: Every party works from the same claim record, so your client, the insurer and the repairer each see the current status without anyone chasing by hand.

faq.question: Can we evidence our service levels?
faq.answer: Yes. Service levels and binder obligations are tracked step by step and kept on the record, ready for any review.

hero.title: More claims per adjuster, within every mandate
hero.summary: True Aim acts as your agentic orchestration layer, computing coverage line-by-line against each insurer's specific wording. We test every invoice against empirical market benchmarks and preserve every outcome with line-level provenance. Eliminating the navigation tax frees your adjusters for critical judgement, giving your portfolio the room to scale.

faq.question: Can True Aim apply different rules for each insurer?
faq.answer: Yes. Each insurer's policy wording, limits and mandate are set up separately, and every claim is decided within the rules of the client it belongs to.

faq.question: Who makes the final decision?
faq.answer: Your adjusters, within the mandate the insurer has given you. True Aim prepares the recommendation and its reasoning, and the record shows who confirmed each outcome.

faq.question: How do we answer an insurer's audit?
faq.answer: From the record. Every decision carries its clause, its evidence and its author, and the full history of a claim exports as one audit pack.

faq.question: Do we have to change our claims system?
faq.answer: No. True Aim works above the systems you already run and writes its results back into them.

hero.title: Every warranty invoice checked against the terms
hero.summary: True Aim breaks invoices down to the line item, validating parts, labour and fees against warranty terms and regional benchmarks in real time. Any discrepancy triggers a ready-to-send reissue request with the exact lines identified, turning costly disputes into fast, objective reconciliations.

quote.text: I believed in this automation from day one, because it decides nothing we had not already decided ourselves. Our experts wrote the rules, True Aim built them into the system, and every answer shows the document and the clause behind it. Routine claims are settled in minutes, and my team can focus on the cases where their experience really counts. I can only recommend that every insurer take a close look at this.
quote.name: Giuseppe Chiarello

faq.question: Which documents does True Aim read?
faq.answer: The garage invoice or estimate, the warranty terms and the supporting documents that come with each claim, in German, French, Italian, English and more.

faq.question: Is the outcome decided by AI?
faq.answer: No. AI reads the documents. Known parts, exclusions and consumables are settled by fixed rules, and every decision links back to the clause and the source page behind it.

faq.question: Who makes the final decision?
faq.answer: Your adjusters. True Aim prepares the recommendation and its reasoning, and an adjuster confirms or changes it.

faq.question: Can we work from our own rules rather than the warranty terms?
faq.answer: Yes. Industry catalogues and your own business rules work in exactly the same way as the warranty terms.

hero.title: Add the coverage check to the workflow your clients already use
hero.summary: You own the workflow, and True Aim takes care of each decision. We work alongside your team to make claims handling simpler inside your platform, with a record of how every decision was reached that you can pass on to your clients.

faq.question: How does True Aim connect to our platform?
faq.answer: Over an API. Your platform sends the claim, True Aim returns the recommendation, its reasoning and the calculated amount, and your clients continue to work in the screens they know.

faq.question: Can each client use its own rules?
faq.answer: Yes. Policy wording, industry catalogues and a client's own business rules are set up per client, and every decision records the rule version it applied.

faq.question: Who makes the final decision?
faq.answer: Your clients' adjusters. True Aim prepares the recommendation with its full reasoning, and full automation runs only where the client and its regulator permit it.

faq.question: What can we pass on to our clients?
faq.answer: The full record of every decision: the inputs, the clauses applied, the calculation and who confirmed the outcome, exported as one audit pack.
